text: [5] sattimāni bhikkhave dhanāni . katamāni satta saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hirīdhanaṃ ottappadhanaṃ sutadhanaṃ cāgadhanaṃ paññādhanaṃ imāni kho bhikkhave satta dhanānīti . saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hirī ottappiyaṃ dhanaṃ sutadhanañca cāgo ca paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ yassa etā dhanā atthi itthiyā purisassa vā adaḷiddoti taṃ āhu amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ . tasmā saddhañca sīlañca pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ anuyuñjetha medhāvī saraṃ buddhānasāsananti .
